task.description: WF-02 Step 5 -- independently re-verify REQ-369's 8 acceptance criteria against actual current code/tests, not against TEST-RUNNER's step-04 report or requirement_status history. Re-run the frontend gate myself; do not trust the prior report.

result.summary:
Confirmed on branch feature/WF02-REQ369-20260917, HEAD 2cf84a99, clean working tree -- no sibling-session collision this run.

Independently re-ran the full frontend gate myself (not trusting step-04's report):
$ npm run type-check -> tsc -b, exit 0, no output
$ npm run lint -> eslint --max-warnings 0, exit 0, no output
$ npm test -> Test Files 87 passed (87), Tests 599 passed (599), Duration 43.17s (includes PlatformDashboardPage.test.tsx 4 tests, OidcCallbackPage.test.tsx 2 tests, router.req369.test.tsx 1 test, all green)
$ npm run guards -> Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 48 passed (48), including a real vite production build + bundle-scan
All numbers match TEST-RUNNER's step-04 report exactly -- independently reproduced, not copied.

AC1 (PlatformDashboardPage.tsx exists, fixed 'Platform Overview' heading, never calls useTenantContext(), no tenant-branded copy): VERIFIED by direct file read. No import of useTenantContext anywhere in the file; heading is a hardcoded literal 'Platform Overview'; copy is generic ('Tenants', 'Platform Admin Links'). Matches TC-REQ369-01/02.

AC2 (tenant-count tile sourced from tenantsApi.list().total): VERIFIED. Line 18-21: useQuery calls tenantsApi.list(); render at line 61 reads tenantsQuery.data?.total. No new endpoint introduced.

AC3 (non-PLATFORM_ADMIN direct access sees self-gated not-authorized state): VERIFIED, with a note. The implementation redirects to <Navigate to="/instances" replace />, which I initially flagged as a possible mismatch against 'not-authorized state' wording -- checked the codebase's own precedent this AC cites (TenantsPage.tsx line 69-70, HealthDashboardPage.tsx line 33-35) and both use the identical redirect-to-/instances idiom as their 'not authorized' gate. This is genuinely the project's established pattern for this AC's language, not a shortcut. Confirmed satisfied.

AC4 (router.tsx new sibling route, existing two entries unchanged): VERIFIED by diff. `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- web/src/router.tsx` shows exactly a 2-line addition (one import, one route entry for 'platform-dashboard'); the existing `{ index: true }` and `{ path: 'dashboard' }` lines are byte-identical, untouched.

AC5 (OidcCallbackPage.tsx role-conditional navigate): VERIFIED by direct read. Line 72: `navigate(payload.roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN') ? '/platform-dashboard' : '/', { replace: true })`. Both branches covered by OidcCallbackPage.test.tsx TC-REQ369-05/06, both green.

AC6 (real PLATFORM_ADMIN login against live QA, lands on /platform-dashboard, screenshot evidence): NOT SATISFIED YET. No UAT run has occurred in this workflow -- confirmed no UAT-RUNNER handoff exists in handoffs/WF02-REQ369-20260917/ (only steps 00 through 04 present), and a filesystem search turned up no screenshot artifact or UAT execution report referencing REQ-369 anywhere in the repo. This requires a real running QA instance and browser automation, which is UAT-RUNNER's job, not something re-derivable from static analysis or the unit suite.

AC7 (platform-login-routing-by-role.yaml PLATFORM_ADMIN branch updated + re-run against QA): PARTIALLY SATISFIED -- the text-only half is done, the verification half is not. Confirmed via `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/platform/platform-login-routing-by-role.yaml` that FRONTEND-DEV already updated the scenario's PLATFORM_ADMIN branch and its REAL-BEHAVIOR NOTE to describe the new /platform-dashboard destination (committed in 259fd95a, same commit as the code change). But this AC explicitly also requires the scenario be 're-run for real against QA... with the updated pass result quoted' -- that execution has not happened; no pass-result evidence exists anywhere in the repo or handoffs for this run.

AC8 (close-out states ISS-0700 stays open, Unknown-workspace banner gap stays unresolved): NOT YET WRITTEN -- this is DOC-UPDATER's Step 6 job, not something to pre-empt here. Confirmed the precondition is still true and won't be contradicted: docs/issues/ISS-0700.yaml line 33 reads `status: open` right now, and no code in this diff touches TenantDashboardPage's isUnknown banner path (confirmed by the router.tsx diff above -- TenantDashboardPage's own route entries and file are untouched). So DOC-UPDATER can truthfully write AC8's required close-out language once AC6/AC7 evidence exists.

VERDICT: PASS-WITH-PENDING, not FAIL. AC1-AC5 are the code-level acceptance criteria and are genuinely, independently verified against real code and a freshly re-run test suite -- no reason to block or rework any of that work; sending it back for rework would be wasted cycles since nothing is wrong with it. AC6/AC7 are evidence-gathering criteria that structurally require a live QA environment and cannot be satisfied by this role or by re-running the local suite again -- they were never expected to be done by Step 5. Per WF-02's own step ordering, UAT-RUNNER's live-QA run is a normal, expected step between here and DOC-UPDATER's close-out, not a defect in the implementation. Routing to UAT-RUNNER next rather than back to FRONTEND-DEV/TEST-RUNNER; routing to DOC-UPDATER would let Step 6 write a close-out AC6/AC7 explicitly require but that isn't truthful yet.
